tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu hya sa mā dza sa hā dza sā dha na/ bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dri med ye shes gzi 'od ldan// 'bar ba'i sku mnga' dkyil 'khor bdag /dpag med sprul pas 'gro skyob pa// dpal ldan gsang 'dus la phyag 'tshal// yid 'ong ri bo'i drung sogs su// blo ldan zhugs te yid dwang bas// gdong sogs dag byas bsod nams bsag /de rjes chos kun stong par bsam// oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ā tma ko ྅haṃ/

stong pa nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o/ /rdo rje'i gzhi la rab dkar dge /chos 'byung dbus su padma dang*// nyi ma la gnas sna tshogs mdog /rdo rje las byung 'khor lo las// gru bzhi zur bzhi sgo bzhi pa// sna tshogs rgyan ldan kun gyis spras// ba dan dril bus khyab pa ni// kun nas nyams dga'i pho brang bsam// de dbus dbyangs yig rnal bzlog las// zla rgyas grub ste de steng 'dir// gsal byed rnal bzlog dbyangs yig can// 'phros bsdus las gyur hūm̐ yig bltas// mtha' yas sprul pas don bsgrubs nas// rgyal ba mthing ga rab mdzes sgeg /g.yas g.yon dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal// rdo rje dril bu rig mas 'khyud// 'khor lo rin chen padma dang*// ral gri 'bar ba g.yas g.yon phyag /skyil krung rnam par rol pas bzhugs// nam mkha'i tshon ltar rab dwangs bsgom// oṃ dang āḥzhes de bzhin du// hūm̐ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// snying ga'i las 'phros 'od zer gyis// ye shes bkug la dbang bskur bya// de nas thabs chen shes rab mchog /bde chen ngang du snyoms zhugs pas// mi 'gyur thig le'i rnam par zhu// spyan sogs glu yis sad par byas// oṃ dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin bdag nyid nga'o/ /rang nyid zla ba hūm̐ dang ni// mgrin par padma la gnas āḥ /spyi bor 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan// thugs gsung sku yi rdo rje bsgom// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swabhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag nyid nga'o/ de bzhin du/ wā ka dang*/ kā ya bcug pa dang*/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs mdzad nas// rdo rje'i thugs gsung skur mdzad gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rjes su chags pas rdo rje'i rang bzhin nga'o/ /shes rab dam pa'i ngo bo nyid// thabs bcas 'byung ba rang gi lus// dga' bzhis bde gshegs mnyes bya zhes// sngags pas dga' ba kun tu brtsam// oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛ ka hūm̐ swā hā/ rdo rje 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhā twī shwa ri mūṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ hūm̐ gi rdo rje las byung ba// yid tshul dam pa'i chu skyes la// gnas pa'i sngags phreng phyung nas ni// rtse gcig yid kyis bzla bar bya// kun brtag mtshan ma kun las grol// yang dag rig las tha mi dad// zhi sogs las kun sgrub byed rgyu// snying rje can gyis mi 'grub med// dpal ldan gsang chen lhan cig skyes// bsnyen pas dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir// mdor bsdus rim pa 'di brjod pas// skye bos sangs rgyas lnga 'grub shog /gsang chen lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// kha che'i rigs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po buddha shī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan bde chen mgon po la// gus pas btud nas de'i sgrubs thabs// sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung bzhin du// mdo tsam bdag gis bshad par bya// skyabs sems bsod nams tshogs bsags sogs spyi dang mthun/ srung 'khor chos 'byung pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su dbyangs bcu drug nyis 'gyur las zla ba/ gsal byed so bzhi nyis 'gyur dbyangs bcu gnyis dang bcas pa las nyi ma/ dbus su hūm̐ yig dang bcas pa'i 'phro 'du gcig tu gyur pa las/ rdo rje 'chang chen po mthing ga nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma rang dang 'dra ba la 'khyud pa/

lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang padma/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang ral gyi 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ ye shes sems dpa' dbang lha dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ rjes su chags pa byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i lha mo spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug ces sogs shlo ka bzhi 'am/ oṃ ma hā su khaṃ badzra sa twa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ su ra ta st+waṃ ḍṛ shya hoḥ zhes bskul bas/ sngon bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ snying gar zla ba la hūm̐/ mgrin par padma la āḥ spyi bor 'khor lo la oṃ rnams thugs gsung sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du spyan drangs/ gnas gsum du thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin du wāka dang kā ya zhes 'don pa spo/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje thugs gsung skur mdzad gsol// ces bskul rjes chags kyi bde bar bsgom zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa gtso bor bzla zhing*/ de'i bcu cha/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhā twī shwa rī hūm̐ swā hā/

zhes pa bzla'o// thun gyi mthar/ snod bcud thams cad 'od gsal du bsdus nas mnyam par bzhag gtor ma'ang bla med spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas 'bul lo// 'di'i slob ma rjes 'dzin ni/ rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba kho na yin no// kun nas rnyed dka' ches zab pa// dga' chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam// bskyed rim snying po'i sgrub thabs 'di// nyer mkhor mthong nas gsol bar bris// 'di 'phags skor dang mthun shas che'ang*/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs yin par shes par bya'o// gsang ba 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// ༈ /gsang 'dus lhan skyes kyi rjes gnang gi zin bris nyung gsal bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rjes gnang la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni stegs bu'i khar maṇḍal tshom bu gcig pa'i mdun du mchod gtor dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod sogs bsham/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs kyi skyabs sems dang*/ spro na tshogs bsags spyi ltar bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor chos 'byung sogs nas/ rjes chags kyi bde ba bsgom pa'i bar sgrub pa'i thabs rin chen 'byung gnas ltar bdag gi rnal 'byor gsal btab/ bzlas dmigs ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la hūm̐/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrubs/ slar 'dus sa bon la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la bzlas pa ci nus bya/ mthar snod bcud thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su thim/ de las slar yang rang skad cig gis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur bsams la/ tshom bu oṃ āḥbi ghnān ta kṛ ta hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor sogs nas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar gsal btab/

mchod pa bsang sbyang*/ byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me'i steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa sbyangs rtogs sbar bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis brlab/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod par sems bskyed gsal btab/ de la 'dir rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa thabs kyi rgyud gdul bya 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul ba dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la/ 'phags yul du 'dus pa 'phags zhabs kyi lugs gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' srol mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam byung bar grags shing*/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'phags skor dang*/ ye shes zhabs lugs gnyis grags che la/ gzhan yang shīnti pa/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ padma badzra/ kun dga' snying po rnams kyi lugs kyang ci rigs par 'gyur ba las/ 'dir sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub zhabs kyi dgongs pa dang mthun par/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po sgeg pa'i rdo rjes legs par bkral ba'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇḍal phul/ gsol 'debs nas brtsams te rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi spyi dang 'dra ba la/ thugs kyi rjes gnang phyag mtshan bstim pa nyid yin te/

kho bos byas pa'i ni ri ti pa'i lugs kyi byams pa'i rjes gnang la lha'i mtshan dang*/ mngon rtogs/ sngags rnams kha spos pa tsam gyis kyang legs par 'grub bo// gsum pa ni/ tshom bu'i lha la mchod bstod/ nongs pa bshags/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ bsngo smon shis brjod spyi ltar bya'o// zhes pa'ang rang 'dra'i blo gros shin tu dman pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa kho nas bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa sarba su shre so bha ba tu// //maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
